description: This file contains the server-side code for the 'ShowAns' webpage in the Online Exam System. It handles loading and displaying students' answers from the database, updating marks, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET WebForm showing students' answers and handling related actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Loads student answers from the database for each question when the page loads, if session variables are set.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with the student's marks, removes student from course queue, and navigates to the admin course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
